notes: Manufacturer's official spec page (docs.cloud.sennheiser.com, part of sennheiser.com) confirms: single integrated male XLR-3 connector serving as both balanced audio output and phantom-power input (48V ±4V, P48/IEC 61938, 4.4mA draw). No separate DC/power jack exists on the device — power arrives via the same XLR-3 pins as the signal, or via 2x AA battery (1.5V/1.2V) inside the body with no external connector needed for that mode. No grade applies (analog audio connector). The box includes a KA 600 XLR-to-3.5mm-TRS adapter cable for direct camera mounting, and a KA 600i variant; these are accessory cables, not additional physical ports on the microphone itself, so they are not listed as separate device ports. No rack units (handheld/shoe-mount shotgun mic, not rack equipment).

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Balanced audio output; also receives 48V ± 4V phantom power (P48, IEC 61938) on the same integrated male XLR-3 connector. Can alternatively be powered by 2x AA battery (no phantom needed) while still using this XLR-3 for signal out. Sennheiser includes a KA 600 XLR-to-3.5mm TRS adapter cable for camera use, but the mic's own fixed connector is XLR-3.
